catalog.app.name: StrideBrain
catalog.home.title: Every completed project should make the next project easier.
catalog.home.description: StrideBrain connects projects, documents, quotations, suppliers, and company knowledge into evidence-backed operating intelligence and governed action.
catalog.home.foundationTitle: Current stage: first complete intelligence workflow
catalog.home.foundationDescription: This build includes a bilingual Project Workspace, governed authorization, explainable historical-project ranking, and a commercial comparison that keeps quoted price and actual cost distinct. All records belong to the fictional Horizon Atelier demo organization.
catalog.home.nextTitle: What the controlled demo can show now
catalog.home.nextDescription: Open the Xinyi Flagship project and ask “Have we done something like this before?” to see explainable precedents, commercial differences, and exact supporting evidence and calculation traces. The governed internal review action follows in the accepted build sequence.
catalog.projects.title: Projects are the operating center of StrideBrain.
catalog.projects.description: The controlled demo connects Horizon Atelier's fictional projects, quotes, forecasts, reconciled actual costs, suppliers, and evidence. The first complete workflow begins inside Xinyi Flagship Renovation.
catalog.knowledge.title: Connect what the company knows—not just where files are stored.
catalog.knowledge.description: The comparison workflow already uses projects, quote versions, costs, suppliers, materials, and evidence. Full knowledge exploration and arbitrary document ingestion are not active yet.
catalog.stridebrain.title: StrideBrain is not another generic chatbot.
catalog.stridebrain.description: The current build resolves authorized work context first, then produces deterministic project ranking, commercial comparison, and honest insufficiency states. Model-written explanation is not required for the critical workflow.
catalog.settings.title: Identity, permissions, language, and data boundaries are governed server-side.
catalog.settings.description: The controlled demo validates roles, project assignments, and redaction. Full account administration, integrations, and real-customer data lifecycle controls are not active yet.
catalog.project.unavailableTitle: This project or project area is currently unavailable.
catalog.project.unavailableDescription: The current authorization context cannot open this project, or the requested area is not active in the first complete workflow. The application does not replace unavailable states with invented records.
catalog.project.foundationDescription: Project Overview, Compare, and claim-level Evidence use the real data and authorization boundaries. Commercial detail pages and Actions activate through the accepted implementation sequence.
catalog.state.notConnected: This area is not active yet
catalog.footer.dataBoundary: Synthetic demo data only · No real customer data
catalog.footer.releaseBoundary: Live demo-domain cutover has not occurred

comparison.description: StrideBrain ranks authorized historical projects with deterministic factors, keeps commercial authority distinct, and shows where evidence is incomplete.
comparison.heroQuestion: Have we done something like this before?
comparison.heroPrompt: Search the authorized project history, explain the strongest matches, and compare the current quotation with trustworthy precedents.
comparison.sessionRequiredTitle: A controlled demo session is required.
comparison.sessionRequiredDescription: This workspace only opens after the server validates a signed synthetic-demo session. Browser parameters cannot select an organization or role.
comparison.unavailableDescription: The project or stored run is not available under the current authorization context.
comparison.failedTitle: StrideBrain could not complete the comparison.
comparison.failedDescription: No unsupported conclusion was shown. Use the reference ID when reviewing the failure.
comparison.contextIncompleteTitle: The current project needs more structured context before comparison.
comparison.noHistoryTitle: No authorized historical projects meet the comparison policy.

selection.title: Choose precedents to compare
selection.description: Select up to three projects. Updating the set creates a new immutable economics enrichment without changing the structural ranking.
selection.errorMaximum: Select no more than three projects.

table.title: Structured comparison
table.description: Values come from the stored deterministic run. Quoted price, forecast, supplier offer, and reconciled actual cost remain separate.

synthesis.title: Structured review
synthesis.quoteAbove: The current quotation is above the selected quoted-price history.
synthesis.actualAbove: The current forecast direct cost is above the eligible reconciled-actual history.
synthesis.stoneReview: Imported stone is the strongest evidence-backed variance and deserves focused review.
synthesis.lightingGap: Lighting is above quoted history, but actual-cost evidence is below the required threshold.
synthesis.programmeDifference: The current programme is shorter than the selected history, but no supported percentage premium is available.
synthesis.nextReview: Validate imported-stone and lighting assumptions internally before quote approval.
synthesis.noEconomics: Commercial evidence is restricted or unavailable; the structural comparison remains usable.

notices.staleSupplier: Supplier offers are historical and must not be presented as current pricing.
notices.conflict: Conflicting evidence is visible and excluded from authoritative aggregates.
notices.insufficientActual: Some categories do not have enough reconciled actual-cost evidence.
notices.restricted: Commercial values are restricted under the current role.
notices.synthetic: Synthetic Horizon Atelier demo data—not a market benchmark.

comparison.actionComingLater: Internal review action becomes available in Stage 8.

evidence.previewRestricted: Preview content is restricted under the current role.
evidence.noSources: No authorized source can be shown for this selection.
evidence.unavailable: This evidence selection is unavailable under the current context.

evidence.restricted: Evidence is restricted under the current role.
evidence.staleRun: This stored comparison is stale. It remains inspectable but cannot authorize a new action.

warningLabels.INSUFFICIENT_ACTUAL_COST_EVIDENCE: Actual-cost evidence is below the required threshold.
warningLabels.CONFLICTED_EVIDENCE: Conflicting evidence was excluded from the authoritative calculation.

review.entryDescription: Review the verified findings, choose the wording and assignee, then explicitly create an internal review action.
review.reviewDescription: Review the evidence and uncertainty before creating this action.
review.title: Title
review.boundedEditHint: Choose review wording. Verified findings and uncertainty statements remain attached and cannot be changed here.
review.findings: Verified findings · retained with the action
review.uncertainty: Uncertainty and limits · retained with the action
review.assigneeLocked: The suggested assignee is fixed for your current access.
review.dateHint: Optional. Enter a date from {min} through {max}, or leave it blank.
review.consequence: Confirmation creates a persistent internal action and an audit record. This screen cannot undo creation. It does not approve a quotation or send a message.
review.acknowledgement: I have reviewed the evidence and limits and want to create this internal review action.
review.receiptDescription: This receipt records the action saved to the project.
review.receiptUnavailableDescription: This receipt cannot be displayed. Return to a project you can access to view available actions.
review.replayTitle: This internal review action was already created
review.replayDescription: The same saved receipt is shown. No additional action was created.
review.actionsDescription: Open a saved receipt to inspect its details and return to the source comparison.
review.actionsEmpty: No internal review actions are currently available here.

states.PROPOSAL_UNAVAILABLE: This review is unavailable. Open an authorized comparison with the required evidence and try again.
states.PROPOSAL_EXPIRED: This review has expired. Return to the comparison and prepare a new review.
states.PROPOSAL_STALE: The comparison or its evidence has changed. Refresh the comparison before preparing a new review.
states.PROPOSAL_NOT_AUTHORIZED: This review is unavailable with your current access.
states.PROPOSAL_FAILED: The review could not be prepared. Try again from the comparison.
states.ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED: This action is unavailable with your current access.
states.ACCESS_CHANGED: Your access has changed. Return to a comparison you can access before continuing.
states.ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE: The assignee is no longer available for this review. Reopen the review to check the current assignment.
states.EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Required evidence is no longer available. Return to the comparison to review access and sources.
states.STALE_COMPARISON: The comparison or its evidence has changed. Nothing was created. Refresh the comparison and review it again.
states.PROPOSAL_ALREADY_CONSUMED: This review has already been used. Open the saved action from the project actions list.
states.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This confirmation does not match the saved request. Reopen the review or its saved receipt before continuing.
states.ACTION_CREATE_FAILED: The action could not be confirmed. Retry the same confirmation to safely recover its saved receipt if it was created.
states.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the highlighted fields before confirming.

validation.INVALID_TITLE: Choose one of the available review titles.
validation.INVALID_RATIONALE: Choose one of the available review purposes.
validation.INVALID_DUE_DATE: Enter a valid date within the displayed range, or leave it blank.
validation.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Confirm that you have reviewed the evidence and want to create the action.
validation.INVALID_REQUEST: Reopen the review and check the entered information.

catalog.app.name: StrideBrain
catalog.home.title: 讓每一個完成的專案，都能幫助下一個專案。
catalog.home.description: StrideBrain 將專案、文件、報價、供應商與公司知識連結成可查證、可採取行動的營運智慧。
catalog.home.foundationTitle: 目前階段：第一個完整智慧工作流程
catalog.home.foundationDescription: 此版本已建立雙語專案工作區、權限治理、可解釋的歷史專案排序，以及報價與實際成本分開的商務比較。所有資料皆為禾序空間設計的虛構示範資料。
catalog.home.nextTitle: 目前可展示的核心成果
catalog.home.nextDescription: 從信義旗艦店專案提出「我們以前做過類似的案子嗎？」，查看可解釋的歷史專案、商務差異，並開啟精確資料依據與計算過程。內部審查事項將依建置順序啟用。
catalog.projects.title: 專案是 StrideBrain 的營運核心。
catalog.projects.description: 受控示範已連接禾序空間設計的虛構專案資料、報價、預估、已核對實際成本、供應商與資料依據。第一個完整流程從信義旗艦店專案開始。
catalog.knowledge.title: 連結公司知道的事，而不只是管理檔案。
catalog.knowledge.description: 目前的比較流程已使用專案、報價版本、成本、供應商、材料與資料依據。完整知識探索與任意文件匯入尚未啟用。
catalog.stridebrain.title: StrideBrain 不是另一個一般聊天機器人。
catalog.stridebrain.description: 目前版本先取得已授權的工作脈絡，再以固定規則產生專案排序、商務比較與誠實的資料不足狀態。模型說明不是主要流程的必要條件。
catalog.settings.title: 身份、權限、語言與資料邊界由伺服器端治理。
catalog.settings.description: 受控示範已驗證角色、專案指派與資料遮蔽；完整帳號管理、整合與正式客戶資料生命週期尚未啟用。
catalog.project.unavailableTitle: 此專案或區域目前無法使用。
catalog.project.unavailableDescription: 目前的授權脈絡無法開啟此專案，或此專案區域尚未在第一個完整流程中啟用。系統不會以假資料取代失敗狀態。
catalog.project.foundationDescription: 專案總覽、比較與資料依據已連接正式資料與權限邊界。商務資料專頁與行動事項會依照已核准的建置順序逐步啟用。
catalog.footer.dataBoundary: 僅使用虛構示範資料 · 無真實客戶資料
catalog.footer.releaseBoundary: 尚未切換正式示範網域

comparison.description: StrideBrain 以可解釋的固定規則排序已授權的歷史專案，清楚區分商務資料權威性，也會誠實呈現資料不足之處。
comparison.heroQuestion: 我們以前做過類似的案子嗎？
comparison.heroPrompt: 搜尋已授權的歷史專案、說明最接近的原因，並用可信任的歷史依據比較目前報價。
comparison.sessionRequiredTitle: 需要受控的示範工作階段。
comparison.sessionRequiredDescription: 伺服器驗證已簽署的虛構示範工作階段後，才會開啟此工作區。網址參數不能選擇組織或角色。
comparison.unavailableDescription: 目前的授權脈絡無法存取此專案或已儲存的比較結果。
comparison.failedTitle: StrideBrain 無法完成此次比較。
comparison.failedDescription: 系統沒有顯示未經支持的結論。檢查問題時請使用參考編號。
comparison.contextIncompleteTitle: 目前專案需要更多結構化資料才能進行比較。
comparison.noHistoryTitle: 沒有已授權的歷史專案符合比較規則。

selection.title: 選擇要比較的歷史專案

selection.errorMaximum: 最多只能選擇三個專案。
